messages.text: What tech stack does Steve use?

claims.text: Across Oak Labs, EcoSmartLoop, and Oakminder, Steve uses technologies including React Native, GCP, Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, FastAPI, Convex, and Expo.
For Oak Labs, the listed technologies are React Native, WebMCP, MCP, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and GCP.
For EcoSmartLoop, the stack includes Next.js, TypeScript, Capacitor, Supabase, Prisma, BetterAuth, AWS, FastAPI, Python, Vercel AI SDK, Tremendous, and Motion.
For Oakminder, Steve chose Convex to make real-time data changes easier to build without spending the whole project buried in infrastructure decisions, pairing it with Expo, Clerk, and RevenueCat.
